name: Daybreak Masjid
summary: A pearl mosque rests beneath a generous rising sun, suggesting the calm start of a prayer day.
why: The sun and main dome share the same centerline. A continuous mosque foundation holds two identical minarets, while a broad open interval keeps the sunlight visually separate from the architecture.
risk: The sun is expressed as an open arc, so it can also suggest a protective halo. The mosque remains the clearest cue.
sub2: A calm beginning for the prayer day

palette.name: DAYBREAK MASJID / DEEP BLUE + PEARL + GOLD

reasonToChoose: You want a prayer identity that feels warm at the start of each day.
